dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: the public index for the fixed AHL 7 (2024) 1245-1299 source (search terms random transposition, recombination, propagation of chaos, Kac, local central limit), the two same-source prepared cards, the 400 retired claims and the probability scouting notes for source 1065.

compared.actual_statement: source 375-389: particle-number-uniform modified logarithmic Sobolev / entropy-production bounds for strictly separating generalized random transpositions
compared.difference: That item bounds entropy production uniformly in the particle number; the new claim compares the k-particle marginals of a conditioned product measure with p^{otimes k} in total variation, with no entropy and no generator. The public index has no local-central-limit entry at all, and the proof 606-717 shares no span with 375-389.

That card compares two nonlinear recombination solutions with equal one-site marginals (statement 1100-1106, proof 948-1263). The new claim is about a conditioned product measure on the fixed-density shell Omega_{rho_N} and is proved by Fourier inversion; neither statement nor proof spans overlap.

That card proves uniform-in-time propagation of chaos for the finite particle system with an explicit empirical initial error (statement 916-924, proof 948-1870). The new claim is a static equivalence-of-ensembles statement for one conditioned product measure and uses no tree, no Wild expansion and no generator comparison; its proof 606-717 lies outside that card's proof package.
Different paper and different object: a regularity lemma for the limiting nonlinear Markov chain, not a total-variation rate for a conditioned product measure.
